Overview

Jubail is a city in Eastern Province with a population of 475,000. A major industrial city in the Eastern Province, home to the world’s largest petrochemical complex. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
